thread:
Priya Nair: AE flagged a request from Ember for a pricing tweak: they run high-volume summarization and want a per-model quantization discount band (e.g., 8-bit models priced lower per-token). They want it surfaced as a purchasable add-on.

Omar Ruiz: Quick Q: are they asking for a general discounted SKU for quantized models or a negotiated customer-specific rate?

Priya Nair: Prefer a productized "Quant Discount" add-on with volume tiers, but they asked if we can apply different discounts per model family (transformer-small vs transformer-large).

Jules Kim: Engineering: we already track model variant metadata in billing pipeline. Applying a tag-based pricing rule is doable. Effort: ~5 days for billing-rule engine + 2 days to propagate tags to reporting. Runtime impact: none.

Tara Lee: Product POV: need to avoid confusion in the Console. Suggest offering two flavors: (1) Public quant-discount SKU with fixed discounts by model class, (2) Enterprise-negotiated override for bespoke rates.

finance-bot: Reco: Start with public SKU bands to simplify revenue recognition. Proposed bands: 10% off for 8-bit small, 18% off for 8-bit medium, 25% off for 8-bit large given 12M+ monthly tokens committed.

Omar Ruiz: Pricing-testing idea: launch pilot with Ember on a 3-month commit requiring 6M tokens/month to unlock medium band. Track uplift and cost delta.

Jules Kim: Implementation details: billing rule table keyed by model_tag + commitment_band. Example row: {model_tag: "8bit-medium", min_commit: 6000000, discount_pct: 18}. Will need UI to show "estimated savings" pre-purchase.

Priya Nair: Launch criteria proposal:
- Public SKU published in pricing docs
- Console purchase flow + estimate calculator
- Pilot with 1 customer (Ember) and metrics tracked: realized discount, model usage shift, margin impact
- Legal-approved T&C for model-tagging accuracy

Tara Lee: UX: Console should show per-model effective price and a toggle to "apply quant discount" when customer has the add-on. Also show a warning if usage shifts to non-discounted models.

finance-bot: Risk: customers may game by switching to lower-quality quant variants. Suggested guardrail: quality-preservation clause and monitoring for quality regressions; revenue protection via min-commit or step-down discounts if usage shifts.

Omar Ruiz: Ops: add monitoring alert for >15% month-over-month shift into discounted variants to flag potential abuse.

Jules Kim: Dev tasks estimate:
- Billing rules + reporting: 5d
- Console UI changes + estimator: 3d
- Docs + T&C: 2d
- Monitoring rule + runbook: 1d

Priya Nair: Action items: Priya -> scope pilot terms with Ember; Omar -> draft discount bands and pilot sizing; Jules -> RFC for billing-rule implementation; Tara -> mockup Console purchase flow. Decision date: next Wed EOD.

Tara Lee: I'll put the mockups in Figma and link here.
